patch_description: This redesign separates permutation utilities, replica allocation, bounded local-search packing, hierarchy orchestration, and output-map construction. GPU packing now uses a batched best-swap refinement from the most-loaded pack against every eligible destination item, rather than only swapping between the heaviest and lightest packs. This preserves exact GPU capacity while reducing placement makespan more reliably. Metadata construction remains flattened and scatter-based to avoid per-expert Python work.
